title: Benefit from public unlabeled data: A Frangi filter-based pretraining network for 3D cerebrovascular segmentation
mechanism: Pretrain on public unlabelled data with Frangi-filter-derived multi-task targets, then fine-tune.
adaptation: Bold bet: pretrain whole U-Net++ (decoder included) on the 11.9k pool to regress multi-scale dark-ridge maps plus the periodic notch residual; PF fine-tune so the pretraining survives.
min_experiment: Arm: ridge-pretrained 40k steps then PF; baseline PF from ImageNet; kill if crack IoU (CV) < +0.012 and E1 relF1@2 < +0.02. About 20 GPU-h.
evidence: R: 1,510 unlabelled TOF-MRA scans, about +3% over semi- and self-supervised methods.
prior_overlap: partial: MIM and DDeP pool pretraining n.d. (section 5), but ridge-target / thin-structure objectives are listed as open
